text:
sara: Follow-up from the console split RFC: we need to decide where RBAC lives when we introduce shard-aware routing + model-local KV caches. Short thread to lock this down.
tom: My 2c: do auth in the router/allocator so we short-circuit and avoid warming KV caches for unauthorized requests. That keeps executors dumb.
emily: Agreed on fail-fast, but router will need a tiny auth cache and hooks to revoke. Risk: permission revocations -> temporary false-positives. How fast do we need revocation?
sara: For console internal users, sub-1min is fine. For admin revokes we want near-immediate. Propose hybrid: short TTL (10s) + push invalidation for admin events.
raj: If allocator does auth, we also need to tag the shard key consistently so cache locality isn't destroyed. Proposal: shard_key = (tenant_id, model_variant_cohort, quant_profile). That groups similar workloads.
tom: Nice. Also add an affinity window so we keep sticky routing for 5s to help in-flight KV cache reuse.
emily: Two implementation concerns: 1) allocator state growth (per-tenant auth entries), 2) increased miss rate on cold start. For (1) limit with LRU and per-tenant caps; for (2) seed warmers for top tenants/models.
sara: Warmers: run cache-populate jobs after code push, and warm on first observed request by prefetching top N prefixes. We'll surface progress in console metrics.
raj: Tests? need a smoke that flips a user's role and verifies deny within 10s. Also need perf test for cache-miss amplification when we split by quant_profile.
emily: I'll add an experiment harness to simulate skewed prefix distributions and measure kv_hit_rate and p95.
tom: Metrics to watch for canary: p50/p95 latency, kv_hit_rate, auth_stale_rate, shard_imbalance_ratio, error_rate(5xx), cost_per_token. Rollback if p95 increases > 15% or auth_stale_rate > 2%.
infra-bot: ci: canary rollout job queued for infra-staging at 2026-04-02T05:00Z
sara: Ownership: TOM -> allocator auth + invalidation hooks (CONSOLE-1501), EMILY -> cache warmer + perf harness (CONSOLE-1502), RAJ -> routing affinity and shard key rollout (CONSOLE-1503).
emily: Quick smoke snippet for the revoke test:
```bash
# send request (should be allowed)
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer TEST_USER" -X POST https://console.internal/api/v1/run -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
# revoke via admin webhook
curl -X POST https://auth.internal/revoke -d '{"user_id":"test_user"}'
# retry until deny (loop checks every 2s, timeout 30s)
```
raj: Also add an audit log entry for allocator decisions so we can trace allow/deny in postmortems.
sara: Thanks all. We'll gate the change behind a feature flag per-tenant and start with 5% of total traffic for 24h. Follow-ups: CONSOLE-1501, CONSOLE-1502, CONSOLE-1503. Sync Thursday 10am to review canary metrics.
